column2: Launch-critical — the pages that carry the shared entry point and the two primary conversions (freight quote, driver apply). Build first.
Launch — trust, self-qualification and second-step pages that materially affect conversion and SEO. Build in the first pass.
Launch — supporting/niche program pages. Valuable but sequenced after P0/P1.
Phased — the ongoing content programme (Phase 4). Build after the Phase 1 launch set.
